title: Reference images: CLIP vision, unCLIP and style models

questions.q: What does StyleModelApply do to the text tensor?
options: Adds the picture's rows on the end, along tokens
questions.answer: Adds the picture's rows on the end, along tokens

questions.q: Which field of the vision output does unCLIP use?

options: Numbers describing a picture, not a new picture
questions.answer: Numbers describing a picture, not a new picture
questions.why: It returns an output object with embeddings.

questions.q: You add unCLIPConditioning on an SD 1.5 model. What should you expect?
options: No effect, since that model class doesn't read the key
questions.answer: No effect, since that model class doesn't read the key
questions.why: unclip_conditioning is read only by classes that look for it.

questions.q: A style model at multiply strength 0 is
options: Still there as zero rows the model attends to
questions.answer: Still there as zero rows the model attends to
questions.why: The lab shows 85 tokens with zero rows. Bypass the node to turn it off.

questions.q: How does load_style_model pick the architecture?
options: By looking for keys in the file
questions.answer: By looking for keys in the file
questions.why: style_embedding gives StyleAdapter, redux_down.weight gives Redux, and anything else raises.
